title: Calibrated Claims
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact. Output of claim-strength-calibrator. Each calibrated claim carries a strength label and an optional caveat. strength is capped when delta < variance (derived by claim_calibration.py). Agents never self-cite as strong when variance overlaps the delta.

source_ref.description: Reference to the result_summary or claim_list this was calibrated from

original_claim.description: The original wording of the claim before calibration

metric.description: Metric this claim refers to (null if claim is qualitative)

variance.description: 1-sigma or half-CI estimate of variance/std around the delta

strength.description: Calibrated strength label — capped to marginal/inconclusive when delta < variance

calibrated_claim.description: The rewritten or confirmed claim text after calibration

caveat.description: Optional caveat text explaining the calibration decision

downgraded.description: True iff the claim strength was reduced from the original

calibrated.description: List of calibrated claims. minItems 1 ensures non-empty output.
